topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: Well, listen to this, the cobbler's son says his sister met a young maiden from the market, and she's been sending him letters. Turns out, this maiden, she lives just a few fields over, on the edge of the forest. Can you believe it? They've been talking all this time, like spirits in the night, and now they live so close. The lad didn't know what to do with himself when he found out. I told him to fetch her some fresh eggs and apples, maybe invite her to the harvest festival. It's a blessing, surely, but it's making the lad fumble his words and stumble over his feet. I reckon he'll be needing a bit of St. George’s courage come the next time he sees her.
